desc: Analyze the problem structure: hierarchical majority voting on a ternary tree of depth N.
Design a bottom-up dynamic programming approach where each node computes the min cost to evaluate to 0 or 1.
Define base cases for leaves (cost 0 if bit matches target, 1 otherwise).
Define recursive step: for an internal node, cost to be 1 is min cost to have at least two children evaluate to 1; similarly for 0.
Formulate the final answer: if original root is 1, answer is cost to make root 0; else cost to make root 1.
Write the Python solution implementing this logic.
